task_fulfillment.rationale: The single Word SOP substantially addresses warehouse handling, storage, training and records, but needs material correction before use: contradictory wrist-strap testing instructions, insufficiently bounded packaging exceptions, and omitted glove guidance. Conductive storage inserts/trays are also omitted. The cited standard's full text was not consulted, so substantive reference alignment remains unverified. The five-page limit cannot be established from text extraction; rendering and human approval remain separate endpoints. No companion-file inconsistency was observed.
